daily_summary: 当日共 15 个 commit，主要覆盖五个方向：(1) 推测解码正确性——将 draft 与 target 的 Gumbel 噪声流解耦（gumbel_sample 新增必选 is_drafting 参数并加盐），修复随机拒绝采样中的分布偏差，同时统一各 proposer 的采样位置语义；(2) MoE 与 kernel 精度——修复 GDN packed decode 的 beta 精度，调整 MoE 路由 GEMM 的 cuBLAS out_dtype 启用范围（修复 GB10），重构 ROCm 共享 expert 双流 decode 并加入多流安全性/收益 gating；(3) 多模态——Qwen3-VL 内存 profiling 尊重 cap_pixels_per_frame、Qwen2.5/3-VL RoPE 缓存生命周期修复、Qwen3-ASR M-RoPE 位置重建修复、Rust gRPC 前端新增 audio/video 输入；(4) 安全与稳定性——cache_salt 长度上限防 DoS、scale-out transfer 参数校验、SparseAttnIndexer 解除 forward 全局配置依赖、Mamba profiling teardown 清理、Ray 多节点测试稳定性修复；(5) 平台与文档——WSL 下 ROCm 检测增强、HYV4 tool parser 类型标注修复。其中 ROCm 专项占 3 个，AITER MLA 达到 FULL cudagraph 推测解码。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日对 vllm-ascend 影响最大的是推测解码 Gumbel 噪声流解耦（fe755c8）：gumbel_sample 新增必选参数 is_drafting 并引入 2^30 噪声盐，draft 位置语义统一为 P-1，直接调用 gumbel_sample 或继承 vLLM speculator 基类的 Ascend proposer（DFlash/DSpark/Eagle/Medusa 等）必须同步更新，否则会因签名不匹配报错或采样流与验证端不一致。其次是 MoE 路由 GEMM（b5707bf）：allow_cublas_router_gemm 被限定为 CUDA/ROCm 平台，Ascend 上 bf16→fp32 out_dtype 融合路由路径被禁用，需验证路由回退路径的数值一致性。SparseAttnIndexer 的 forward 全局配置解耦（8c51b92）对 Ascend SFA 后端是兼容性提升；vllm/platforms/__init__.py 的 WSL ROCm 检测（1ebff99）按规则标记为影响平台发现模块，但实际仅涉及 ROCm 内置检测，OOT entry-point 机制不受影响。其余 ROCm 专项、多模态模型修复、入口协议校验与 CI/测试变更均不影响 vllm-ascend。

commits.comment: ROCm 平台的双流 decode 性能优化（配合 hipgraphs）。将 SharedExperts 多流重叠机制重构为 maybe_forward_async()/wait() 两段式：在 routed expert dispatch 前把 shared expert 计算异步启动到 aux stream，需要结果时再等待，避免原先启动后立即同步导致的串行化。同时收紧条件：is_multistream_safe() 检查 routed expert 输入是否量化（未量化时 shared expert 输入与 hidden states 存在 alias，双流下有 race condition，仅 ROCm 上观察到）；overlap_is_beneficial 限制 ROCm 上仅 DP-only（tp_size==1）场景启用。SharedExperts.__init__ 新增 is_multistream_safe 回调参数；MoERunner 的 apply 流程相应调整。对非 CUDA/ROCm 平台行为不变（仍走 NO_OVERLAP 同步路径）。

commits.comment: 让 AITER MLA 在 ROCm 上实现 FULL cudagraph 的推测解码。核心改动：(1) 小 head（<16）多 token verify 不再把 (1+num_spec) block 展平成逐 token 的 Gluon decode 并手工截断 KV 窗口，而是直接走 mla_gluon 的 4-D MTP 入口（q 为 [batch, qlen, nhead, dim]，use_2d_view=False），由 kernel 内部施加每位置因果掩码；(2) builder 计算 min_kv_seq_len 时排除 cudagraph padding 行（qo_lens=0 的 dummy 请求按 max_qo_len 垫齐），避免把 Gluon 的 KV-split 并行度压垮；(3) TritonMLAMetadataBuilder 新增 get_cudagraph_support() 覆写：当 KV cache group 含 non_causal_multi_token_decode（DSpark draft 的 1+num_spec 块走 decode 路径）时报告 UNIFORM_BATCH，使整个引擎不再因该 attention group 被降级出 FULL cudagraph。测试同步改写为验证 4-D MTP 契约、padding 行排除逻辑和 UNIFORM_BATCH 判定。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。rocm_aiter_mla.py 为 ROCm 专有后端（Ascend 不使用）；triton_mla.py 的改动是 TritonMLA 后端的 get_cudagraph_support 覆写，Ascend 使用自研 MLA 后端，不经过 TritonMLA。non_causal_multi_token_decode/UNIFORM_BATCH 机制对 Ascend 的 DSpark+ACL Graph 无直接约束。

commits.comment: 修复 family-120（GB10/DGX Spark）上 MoE 路由 GEMM 无法利用 cuBLAS bf16→fp32 out_dtype 融合 epilogue 的问题。原逻辑把 allow_cublas_router_gemm 绑定在 allow_specialized_router_gemm（专用 kernel gate，会排除 family-120）或 ROCm 特例上；新逻辑提取 _router_gemm_cublas_capable = (is_cuda() or is_rocm()) and no_bias 作为独立条件，使所有 CUDA 架构（含 GB10）都能走 cuBLAS/hipBLASLt 的 out_dtype 路由 GEMM，并删除 ROCm 特例分支。副作用：非 CUDA/ROCm 平台（含 Ascend）上该开关不再可能通过 allow_specialized_router_gemm 打开；第二个 hunk 的延迟启用路径（权重 dequant 后重检）也对这类平台永久关闭。

ascend_impact.functionality: GateLinear（vLLM MoE 路由层）的 allow_cublas_router_gemm 现在仅在 CUDA/ROCm 平台为 True。旧逻辑中 Ascend 上若 allow_specialized_router_gemm=True 且权重为 bf16、out_dtype=fp32，可能启用 bf16→fp32 out_dtype 融合路由 GEMM；新逻辑下该路径在 Ascend 上被禁用（is_cuda()/is_rocm() 均为 False），路由回退到 bf16 matmul 后手动 cast fp32 的通用路径。接口未变，但路由计算的数值路径可能变化，需在 Ascend 上验证 MoE 路由（router logits 与 topk 选专家）一致性。
ascend_impact.testing: 建议在 vllm-ascend 的 MoE 测试中覆盖带/不带量化路由的场景，确认 GateLinear 回退路径下路由结果无回归。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/ 路由相关测试（GateLinear 在 bf16 权重下 router logits 与 topk 行为）
MoE 模型 e2e 测试（如 DeepSeek 系列，验证路由回退路径无回归）

commits.comment: （自动判定）仅涉及 tests / docs / CI / 平台特化代码变更，不影响 vllm-ascend。

修复随机推测解码中的分布偏差：draft token 的 Gumbel 采样与 target 的拒绝采样/重采样共享同一 (seed, pos) 噪声流，导致提案被 argmax 拒绝后，残差重采样继承了该提案的同一噪声向量，使与 draft 高排序相邻的 token 被系统性低估。修复方案：gumbel_sample 新增必选参数 is_drafting，draft 采样时对 pos 加盐（_DRAFT_NOISE_SALT=1<<30），使两条噪声流完全不相交；同时统一 draft 位置语义——sample_src_positions 定义为被采样 token 的前一个位置（P-1），AutoRegressive/MultiModuleMTP 每步推进 +1，DFlash 从 P-2 改为 P-1，DSpark 将 target 侧 set_additional_forward_context 的换算保持一致。注意：gumbel_sample 签名是破坏性变更（新增必选参数），所有调用方必须同步更新；draft 噪声流整体偏移会使固定 seed 的复现结果变化。测试新增窄词表分布检验（chi2）与 draft/target 流独立性检验。

ascend_impact.functionality: gumbel_sample() 新增必选形参 is_drafting，并移除旧的 positions+1 约定；DraftModelSpeculator.sample_draft 形参改名 sample_src_positions；AutoRegressiveSpeculator 新增 sample_src_positions 状态缓冲，prepare_decode_inputs/update_draft_inputs 签名增加该参数；DFlash/DSpark 的位置语义从 P-2/Q-1 统一为 P-1。vllm-ascend 的 spec_decode proposer（DFlash、DSpark、Eagle、Medusa 等）若直接调用 gumbel_sample 或继承 vLLM 的 AutoRegressiveSpeculator/MultiModuleMTPSpeculator/DraftModelSpeculator，必须同步更新：draft 采样的 gumbel_sample 调用需传 is_drafting=True，并改用新的 P-1 位置语义；否则会因签名不匹配 TypeError，或采样键与验证端不一致导致分布偏差。同时 draft 噪声流加盐后，Ascend 端固定 seed 的复现期望值需更新。
ascend_impact.testing: 需要更新 vllm-ascend 的 spec_decode 测试：验证各 proposer 调用 gumbel_sample 时传入 is_drafting=True、位置语义为 P-1，以及草案与验证端噪声流解耦后拒绝采样输出分布无偏。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend/spec_decode/（Eagle/Medusa/MultiModuleMTP 等继承 sample_draft 的 proposer）
gumbel_sample 调用兼容性与拒绝采样分布回归测试

commits.message:
[Bugfix][Model Runner V2][Spec Decode] Decouple the draft's gumbel noise stream from the target's (#54282)

Signed-off-by: Giancarlo Delfin <gdelfin@inferact.ai>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py::_prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend (sample_pos semantics consumed as P-1 by inherited upstream DFlashSpeculator.propose)

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/autoregressive/speculator.py::AscendAutoRegressiveSpeculator (inherits new `sample_src_positions` buffer and position arithmetic from upstream AutoRegressiveSpeculator)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) HARD BREAK (mandatory, crashes): upstream adds a new required `is_drafting: bool` to `gumbel_sample()` (after `apply_temperature`). vllm-ascend substitutes its NPU `gumbel_sample` (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/sample/gumbel.py:167) into `vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.sampler`, `...spec_decode.speculator` (base_speculator), `...eagle.speculator`, and `...sample.gumbel` via vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py:28-37. After this commit the upstream Sampler.sample calls gumbel_sample(..., is_drafting=False) and DraftModelSpeculator.sample_draft calls gumbel_sample(..., is_drafting=True). The Ascend function must accept `is_drafting` and pass it to `_gumbel_sample_kernel` as `IS_DRAFTING: tl.constexpr`, otherwise ALL non-greedy target sampling on NPU (and probabilistic draft sampling) raises TypeError. 2) CARRY OVER THE FIX (correctness): this commit's point is to decouple the draft Gumbel stream from the target's via `_DRAFT_NOISE_SALT = 1<<30` added to `pos` only when drafting (upstream gumbel.py `_DRAFT_NOISE_SALT` / `IS_DRAFTING`). The NPU draft kernel keys noise by `tl.randint(seed, pos)` (gumbel.py:149) and the NPU resample keys by the same `pos` (rejection_sampler_utils.py `_npu_gumbel_block_argmax`:71), so the identical bug exists on NPU. In `_gumbel_sample_kernel`, when `block_temp != 0.0 and IS_DRAFTING`, salt the position before `tl.randint`: `pos = (pos + (1 << 30))` (NPU pos is already cast to int32; 1<<30 fits in int32 as positions stay < 2^30 — verify at extreme max_model_len). Leave the target-side resample unsalted (decoupling is draft-side only). 3) Speculator arithmetic: `AscendAutoRegressiveSpeculator` inherits the upstream AutoRegressiveSpeculator changes (new `self.sample_src_positions` buffer created in upstream __init__, `_prefill` passing `positions + 1`, `_generate_draft` reading the buffer, `prepare_decode_inputs`/`update_draft_inputs` advancing it in `_prepare_decode_inputs_kernel`/`_update_draft_inputs_kernel`); because Ascend delegates via super() (propose/_prefill/_generate_draft/_multi_step_decode) this self-adapts as long as the gumbel_sample signature fix lands. The upstream dflash speculator now passes `sample_pos - 1` (was -2); the Ascend `_prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend` computes `sample_pos` identically to upstream so it stays compatible — verify only. Upstream DSparkSpeculator passes `is_drafting=True` to its module-local gumbel_sample; confirm the Ascend DSpark path applies the salt (or its own gumbel call). 4) Tests: update tests/ut/sample/a2/test_gumbel_sampling.py for the new `is_drafting` argument and add NPU regressions mirroring upstream test_drafting_uses_a_separate_noise_stream (same seed/pos must yield different draws when is_drafting toggles) and the rejection-sampler unbiasedness test (test_gumbel_drafted_rejection_sample_is_unbiased).
deep_analysis.risk: High. (a) The signature break is fatal: without accepting `is_drafting`, every non-greedy (temperature) generation step on NPU — not just spec decode — throws TypeError once vllm is bumped past this commit; the same applies to probabilistic draft sampling. (b) Partial adaptation is dangerous: adding the kwarg without implementing the 1<<30 salt leaves the exact acceptance bias this commit fixes silently in place on NPU (draft and residual share a Philox stream keyed by the same `pos`). (c) NPU-specific: pos is cast to int32 for the triton-ascend compiler, so the salt must fit in int32 (1<<30 works only while positions stay below 2^30, matching upstream's assumption); confirm triton-ascend accepts the extra constexpr and int32 add without reintroducing uint64/float64 paths (use_fp64 already rejected on NPU). (d) CUDA-graph capture/replay on the Ascend FULL decode path must include the new `sample_src_positions` buffer updates — verify the buffer is updated in place so captured graphs stay correct.

commits.comment: 修复 batch chat completions 中 echo 参数误回显用户 prompt 的问题。原逻辑只要最后一条消息有 content 就回显，不检查角色；现在要求最后一条消息的 role 必须等于当前 response_role（默认 assistant）才回显。测试覆盖了两种场景：仅用户消息时只返回模型生成内容，以及存在 assistant 前缀时正确拼接前缀。该改动只影响 OpenAI API batch 服务的文本组装逻辑，行为修复正确，风险低。

commits.comment: 为 SamplingParams 增加 stop_token_ids 的词汇表范围校验，并将 allowed_token_ids 的校验从基于 tokenizer 改为基于 model_config.get_vocab_size()，与 logits 张量实际宽度保持一致。这能在早期捕获越界 token id，避免在生成阶段因索引越界产生未定义行为。改动为纯参数验证逻辑，不改变采样接口和策略，风险低；但需注意极端情况下用户自定义超范围 token id 的请求会被拒绝，这是预期行为。

commits.comment: 为 NIXL KV 连接器添加 MLA 模型的 DCP（decode context parallel）支持，这是一个跨模块的大功能。核心改动包括：(1) VllmConfig 新增 NIXL+DCP 约束断言，并实现 adjust_dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size，在 PD 场景下将 cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 自动调整为本地 block_size；(2) TransferTopology 新增 dcp_source_ranks/dcp_consumer_count，compute_tp_mapping 在 MLA+DCP 下计算正确的 source ranks 和消费者计数；(3) NIXL worker 新增 _apply_dcp_prefix_caching，在逻辑 block 粒度对齐本地/远端 DCP 切片，并扩展 _reqs_need_recv 携带 per-group 的缓存命中计数；(4) MLA 共享层调整：MLACommonImpl 移除 cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 属性，SparseAttnIndexer 改为延迟读取；(5) GPUModelRunner 在 initialize_kv_cache 时快照 cp_interleave，V1 GPUModelRunner 增加 cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 状态追踪。整体设计涵盖配置、拓扑计算、调度、传输和模型层，属于高风险分布式路径改动，对非 NIXL/非 MLA 场景有防护性检查。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py 在 initialize_kv_cache 中新增 self.cp_interleave 属性快照，vllm-ascend 的 NPUModelRunner（V2）继承 GPUModelRunner，若覆写此方法需同步设置该属性，否则后续 InputBatch 重建可能使用错误的 interleave 值。vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py 新增 self.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 并在 may_reinitialize_input_batch 中检查其变化，vllm-ascend 的 V1 model runner（若继承此文件）需要保持该属性同步。vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py 中 MLACommonImpl 删除了 self.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 属性，vllm-ascend 的 MLA 后端子类（如 AscendMLAAttentionImpl）若仍引用该属性将触发 AttributeError，需改为动态从 get_current_vllm_config() 获取。vllm/model_executor/layers/sparse_attn_indexer.py 的 SparseAttnIndexer 将 cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 改为延迟 property，依赖该类的 Ascend SFA/DSA 实现需要适配。vllm/config/vllm.py 新增 adjust_dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size 并在 ensure_kv_transfer_initialized 中无条件调用（只要 kv_transfer_config 非空且 dcp_size>1），Ascend 若使用 Mooncake 等非 Nixl connector 且 DCP 场景下也会触发该调整，需在 Ascend 配置验证中确认兼容性。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 需要增加或更新测试以覆盖：NPUModelRunner（V1/V2）在继承后 cp_interleave/cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 属性的正确设置与 InputBatch 重建行为；Ascend MLA 后端不再访问已删除的 cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 属性；Ascend 平台配置在非 Nixl connector + DCP 下 adjust_dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size 的行为是否符合预期。

commits.message:
[Nixl][PD] DCP support for MLA models   (#50611)

Signed-off-by: NickLucche <nicolo.lucchesi@mistral.ai>

affected_interfaces: NPUWorker.initialize_from_config (vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py:1009-1011) - calls vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_transfer_state.ensure_kv_transfer_initialized, which this commit changed to invoke VllmConfig.adjust_dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size; under Mooncake PD + decode_context_parallel_size>1 it now silently pins parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size to the resolved block_size (128 on Ascend) at worker init.

NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config / _validate_sfa_dcp_kv_sp (vllm_ascend/platform.py:1242-1267, called at line 465) - its hard AssertionError requiring cp_kv_cache_interleave_size == cache_config.block_size for PD/DCP now duplicates and conflicts with upstream's new worker-side auto-adjustment; the strict config-time raise also prevents Ascend users from using the new upstream auto-fix.

Ascend DCP metadata builders / slot-mapping consumers of cp_kv_cache_interleave_size: vllm_ascend/attention/context_parallel/mla_cp.py:75 (AscendMlaDCPMetadataBuilder.__init__), sfa_cp.py:600/892 (AscendSFADCPMetadataBuilder), vllm_ascend/worker/dcp_utils.py:467/656, vllm_ascend/worker/block_table.py, vllm_ascend/worker/npu_input_batch.py, vllm_ascend/_310p/block_table.py & npu_input_batch.py - all read the value at construction/init; must be verified to observe the post-adjustment value (i.e. after NPUWorker.initialize_from_config), or cache it lazily.

NPUModelRunnerV1 / NPUModelRunnerV2 interleave capture timing (vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py:542,4828; vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py) - upstream GPUModelRunner (v2) now snapshots self.cp_interleave inside initialize_kv_cache (additive, no break), but the v1 path reads parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size at block-table/input-batch build time; timing relative to the new worker-side adjustment must be checked.
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit adds Nixl DCP support for MLA; vllm-ascend does NOT use Nixl (it uses Mooncake/MooncakeLayerwise/Offloading connectors registered in vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/__init__.py), so all Nixl-specific changes (TransferTopology.dcp_source_ranks/dcp_consumer_count, ReqMeta.dcp_size/local_num_computed_blocks, compute_tp_mapping local_consumers, NixlPullConnectorWorker._apply_dcp_prefix_caching, NixlPushConnector DCP guard, Nixl-only __post_init__ validation gated by KVTransferConfig.has_connector('NixlConnector')) require NO adaptation. The relevant adaptation targets the shared PD/DCP config path that vllm-ascend uses with Mooncake: (1) vllm_ascend/platform.py _validate_sfa_dcp_kv_sp (lines 1242-1267): reconcile with the new upstream behavior - upstream now auto-adjusts cp_kv_cache_interleave_size to block_size at worker init (VllmConfig.adjust_dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size, invoked from ensure_kv_transfer_initialized which NPUWorker.initialize_from_config calls at worker.py:1011), so consider relaxing the strict AssertionError (or deferring the check to after adjustment) so Ascend PD+DCP users can benefit from the auto-fix and avoid divergence; (2) verify the DCP interleave value consumed by AscendMlaDCPMetadataBuilder.__init__ (attention/context_parallel/mla_cp.py:75) and AscendSFADCPMetadataBuilder (attention/context_parallel/sfa_cp.py:600) and the DCP slot-mapping code (worker/block_table.py, worker/dcp_utils.py:467/656, worker/model_runner_v1.py:542/4828) is read AFTER NPUWorker.initialize_from_config runs the adjustment (or read lazily from parallel_config at forward time), since upstream moved the cp_kv_cache_interleave_size pinning from VllmConfig.validate_block_size (EngineCore side, now skipped for PD) to the worker side; (3) no change needed to MLA/SFA attention impls (they do not subclass upstream MLACommonImpl/SparseAttnIndexer) and no Nixl integration work is required. Add/keep a PD (Mooncake) + DCP + MLA NPU test that asserts cp_kv_cache_interleave_size == 128 after worker init.
